text: If you have an addiction to sweets, do not fight yourself. A bad peace is better than a good war. Try to make an agreement with yourself: when you want something sweet, first eat something containing a lot of protein (eggs, nuts, fish, cottage cheese, legumes), and only then something sweet. You will notice that you want less sweet, and only in this way reduce the portion of sweets. The benefit of such an order of eating is also that spikes in blood sugar are smoothed out. Perhaps after 1–2 weeks you will notice that the craving for sweets stops controlling you, and self-respect appears inside. You can continue to eat sweets, but less, and you begin to feel yourself the master of the situation.
